scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build
scripts.test: docker compose exec api npm test
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec api node database/migrate.js
scripts.migrate:status: docker compose exec api node database/migrate.js status
scripts.db:fresh: docker compose exec api node database/fresh.js --yes
scripts.demo:last-seat: docker compose exec api npm run demo:last-seat
